title: E11 G01 P1-M06 FCI Method configuration, implementation contract
description: Method-specific strict config for Study.method.config when method.id=P1-M06 and backend=causal-learn. Local schema; registered semantically against Study, not a new payload version. No implicit PC defaults.

indep_test.description: fisherz requires continuous eligible numeric observations; chisq and gsq require explicitly integer-coded categories. Never autodiscretize or impute.

depth.description: -1 backend unrestricted; >=0 finite conditioning set depth.

background_knowledge.description: No BK is represented as null. Edges refer to source variable-name pairs in declared data columns. Constraint consistency and backend semantics require separate validation and regression.
